rv.q: This latest pageant gives a decadent spin to the adventures of Little Red Riding Hood through a decadent mélange of slinky dance, explosive live singing and suggestive circus acts.
This grownup-fairy-tale adventure, which runs at the company’s bespoke Théâtre XIV, begins at the door as you enter into the warm crimson glow and incensed haze of the antechamber...
Fierce, sexy, and decadent, Petite Rouge is one of the most unique shows you can see in NYC.

cn.t: Critics praise Company XIV's burlesque spin on Little Red Riding Hood as a transportive, sexy spectacle anchored by strong dancing, though it emphasizes style over substance.
